gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-fresca: Loose, friendly, hand-made. Fresca follows in a plain sans with connected, open shapes, giving those wobbly rounded headings a tidy, modern partner underneath.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-funnel-sans: Fuzzy Bubbles has rounded, hand-drawn letters, with small letters nearly as tall as the capitals, and it earns its keep big and short. Funnel Sans stays in the sans-serif lane, with stroke widths that hold steady and a lowercase e that gapes open.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-gafata: Gafata reads tall and open, with short stalks above its lowercase.  Over a long stretch the sans stays easy on the eye, a steady counterweight to the glass-tubing wobble of Fuzzy Bubbles up top.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-geist: Relaxed, like a doodle on a whiteboard. Geist runs underneath as quiet sans-serif, its words reading as solid blocks, which lets the loose, rounded Fuzzy Bubbles headings do all the talking.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-georama: Georama reads wide and friendly, its c pulled open like a bracelet and its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. A longer page flows smoothly, while Fuzzy Bubbles up top looks like spaghetti laid out in letters.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-gidole: Gidole reads crisp and tidy, with terminals held apart like open scissor blades. Against the hand-drawn Fuzzy Bubbles, its neon-tube consistency is the pair's sharpest quality: one loose, one precisely drawn.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial, Glegoo sets a tall lowercase with big counters beneath the wire-bent Fuzzy Bubbles. And where the heading font is best at loose, personal charm, the serif is best at open, curving text that carries a reader's eye along.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-golos-text: Fuzzy Bubbles draws its rounded, hand-made letters with a drafting pen's steady line, and its small letters nearly match its capitals. And Golos Text, a sans-serif with a tall x-height and a widely parted s, gives the page a modern, approachable footing.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-graduate: Dignified and a bit bookish, Graduate sets its serif letters with generous white between them. A longer passage moves slowly and deliberately, and the relaxed, rounded Fuzzy Bubbles heading above it loosens that formality nicely.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-hanuman: Fuzzy Bubbles has a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, rounded and relaxed. And Hanuman, a traditional serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, keeps a longer passage feeling refined and settled.
